fields.name: q
fields.description: Search query to match against symbol names and meanings. Case-insensitive.

fields.name: letter
fields.description: Filter symbols by starting letter (a-z). Case-insensitive.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Maximum items to return per page. Range: 1-50, default 20.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of items to skip for pagination. Default 0.
